summary: The PR adds a new attribute `refit_time_` to measure the time taken to refit the best model. However, it introduces a dependency on the `time` module and does not include any tests.

issues.description: The PR introduces a dependency on the `time` module without importing it at the top of the file, which is inconsistent with the project's conventions.
The PR does not include any tests to verify the functionality of the new `refit_time_` attribute.
